ruleset.name: employee-management-api
ruleset.description:
Correctness-focused PMD rules for the Employee Management API. Stylistic and documentation rulesets are deliberately excluded: Checkstyle already owns style, and duplicating it produces conflicting demands.
NOTE: excludes must name rules that still exist in the PMD version in use (7.7.0). PMD warns on an exclude that matches nothing — JUnitTestsShouldIncludeAssert was removed in PMD 7 and its exclude was dropped for that reason.
